opening.argument: The video presents practical education about finding online work, offering skills, and becoming an instructor on named platforms. Viewers hear about “sharing your skills online so you sell your skill” and registering to teach, including the choice between free and paid courses. The explanation describes revenue sharing when people enroll: “a percentage of that money will go to the. To the platform and another percentage will go to you.” Although it includes the unverified phrase “Earning money instantly when you sign that instructor form,” the video does not direct viewers to make a payment or provide personal data. That timing claim alone is insufficient to establish deceptive conduct.
